Boa Benchmark Sample Document
==============================

The primary goal of the Boa compression engine is to provide a clean, high-performance,
and secure terminal tool for archiving and decompressing files.

Key Technical Principles:
1. Streaming chunked I/O to avoid buffering large multi-gigabyte files into RAM.
2. Canonical boundary path checks to block Zip-Slip attacks (../../ escapes).
3. Live benchmark comparison across all Deflate compression levels (0 through 9).
4. Interactive terminal raw-mode UI with arrow-key navigation.
5. Deterministic, cross-platform behavior on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Deflate Compression Levels:
- Level 0: Store (no compression, maximum speed)
- Level 1: Best speed / fastest compression
- Level 2-5: Incremental compression balance
- Level 6: Default compression (optimal balance between CPU time and compression ratio)
- Level 7-8: Higher compression
- Level 9: Best compression / maximum space reduction

This text file is structured with repeated technical patterns to simulate realistic source documentation and text logs during compression benchmarking.
